`enum SignalReplayFailure`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayFailure.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/replay/SignalReplayFailure.java)

Kinds of expression that the replay cannot follow, each with its reason and its advice.

## Description

Each value gives the end of the dev warning that names the line.
The advice is always the same idea: compute the value with `map(...)`, with `Signal.from(() -> ...)` or with a lambda read at every frame.

- [Signals](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#what-joid-follows)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`CLASS_NOT_FOUND`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-CLASS_NOT_FOUND) | The bytecode of the calling class cannot be read. |
| [`MEMBER_NOT_FOUND`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-MEMBER_NOT_FOUND) | A field, method or class named in the bytecode does not exist at runtime, for example after a renaming that the [`ISignalReplayBridge`](/reference/bridges/isignalreplaybridge/) does not map. |
| [`CALL_NOT_FOUND`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-CALL_NOT_FOUND) | The call of the setter is not on the line, often because the `.class` file was compiled again since the launch. |
| [`AMBIGUOUS_CALL`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-AMBIGUOUS_CALL) | Several calls of the same setter on one line give the same value from the same signals; write one call per line. |
| [`UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUCTION) | The expression uses an instruction that the replay does not run. |
| [`LAMBDA`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-LAMBDA) | The expression contains a lambda. |
| [`LOCAL_COMBINED`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-LOCAL_COMBINED) | A local variable is combined with a signal in the expression. |
| [`LOCAL_CONDITION`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-LOCAL_CONDITION) | A local variable decides a condition of the expression. |
| [`VALUE_DIFFERS`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-VALUE_DIFFERS) | Running the expression again gives another value than the one received: it has side effects or reads the time or a random value. |
| [`SIGNALS_DIFFER`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-SIGNALS_DIFFER) | Running the expression again reads other signals than the first time. |
| [`ACCESS_REFUSED`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-ACCESS_REFUSED) | The module of a class refuses the reflective access; the advice gives the `opens` line to add to its `module-info`. |
| [`REPLAY_FAILED`](#SignalReplayFailure-value-REPLAY_FAILED) | The replay threw while it ran the expression. |
